notes.title: Patch for September 25​
notes.notes:
[olist]
Added a click-to-view character feature in the Glossary.

Improved prevention of card pack opening freezes and added an error log function.

Reduced the probability of obtaining the ultimate potion "Void" when the player has 8 or more ability cards.

Optimized damage display to avoid showing multiple zeros.
[/olist]

notes.title: September 20 Update
notes.notes:
1.Slightly reduced the probability of common Abilities, and fixed the talent that increases the probability of rare Abilities.

2.Fixed several text descriptions.

3.Increased the level of 5 moves, with adjustments to the calculation rules.

notes.title: September 17 Patch​
notes.notes:
1

​​Added cloud save functionality.​​

2

​​Slightly increased the animation speed for cheat upgrades.​

notes.title: Patch on September 15th
notes.notes:
1.  EXP gain has been increased overall by approximately 10% to 15%.
2.  Some high-level talents have received minor enhancements.
3.  Victory cash rewards in KK Park have been slightly reduced, while starting gold has been increased.
4.  When affected by story points, collection items now gain +1 level for every 3 story points.
5.  Fixed an issue where the top UI was partially obscured in 1920-pixel windowed mode.
6.  Fixed an issue where purchasing coupons would refresh the price of the current free item.

notes.title: September 11th Patch
notes.notes:
1.
Fixed the Kabukicho Gyoen error in Shinjuku.

2.
Fixed the issue where clearing New York did not unlock the protagonist's Red Card.

3.
Fixed the issue where defeating the final boss in Endless Mode granted no experience.

4.
Increased the probability of Cola to 30%.

5.
Adjusted Star Card to affect both Rare and Epic cards;

Adjusted Belfort so that interest gained is subject to the interest cap;

Fixed the value refresh issue with the Opportunistic Profiteer Card.

6.
Slightly increased the stats of some Red Cards.

7.
Slightly reduced the stats of some Rare and Epic cards.

8.
Fixed multiple text errors.

9.
Optimized card display switching issues in the deck interface.

notes.title: September 9 Patch
notes.notes:
1.
Fixed incorrect plot point calculation when unequipping collection gear
2.
Fixed game freeze during cutscene playback after female protagonist clears New York level
3.
Fixed game freeze at battle commencement in Endless Mode
4.
Fixed text description errors on multiple psychic cards

notes.title: ​September 7th Afternoon Patch​
notes.notes:
1.
Fixed the bug where players couldn't obtain plot points after clearing hidden levels.

2.
Slightly enhanced the "Star Shifting" card.

3.
Upon entering Endless Mode, the EXP gained will progressively increase, with a growth rate ranging from 100% to 300%.

notes.title: September 7 Patch
notes.notes:
1.
​​Fixed the black screen issue during initial character selection.​
2.
​​Fixed the issue where achievements fail to activate.​
3.
​​Fixed the freeze/crash issue upon reaching Normal difficulty.​

notes.title: July 15, 2025 Content Update​
notes.notes:
1. Added new heavy hit animation effect​

2. Added 15+ new talents; 5 talents unlocked in the demo version​

3. Added mod support system: Currently enables character customization and character replacements. Built-in test patches are included. Full patches and mod documentation will be released later via Gofile (link) and QQ Group.​

4. Fixed scoreboard display error​

notes.title: Update: June 27, 2025
notes.notes:
Adjustments to Stage EXP:​​ EXP is now awarded after every battle. Clearing hidden stages for the first time grants a large amount of EXP.

​​HP Growth Adjustments:​​

The "Destroy Ability Card" function has been adjusted to only destroy cards with ​​median value or lower​​.

​​Bug Fixes & Optimizations:​​

Fixed the ​​HP NaN bug​​.

Improved Japanese translations.

Fixed issues with certain cards.
